title: Folder browser for a new film
why: File › New film from a folder… shows folders with video counts ('26 videos'), and the button names what it will do: 'Make a film from copper-02-2026 (26 videos)'. Found my footage in four clicks, no typing.

title: Proposal reasons match the picture
why: Checked 9 shots against the Program frame: moving walkway under the United sign, laptop on the plane, skier dropping down a wind-scoured ridge, helmeted friend with the milk jug, sunny run, the milkman crouched with the jug — all true. And it hit my length: asked 90 s, got 1:35.6 in 13 shots.

title: Delete on a timeline shot closes the gap and says how to undo
why: Selected the Walmart car-park shot, pressed Delete: shot gone, gap closed, film 1:29, and a toast 'removed 1 shot — Ctrl+Z brings it back'. Exactly what an iMovie person expects.

title: Hand edit on a title exists and the AI keeps the conversation
why: The title card has 'edit by hand' (words, size, x/y, in/out, Fit to frame, 'no model call'), and a follow-up in the prompt box knew which title I meant and said plainly 'I have not looked at these frames'. Final title on shot 2 reads well.

title: Export warns before a name becomes -2
why: Second export: 'A file named copper-02-2026.mp4 is already there. This export will be saved as copper-02-2026-2.mp4; nothing is overwritten.' Clear and calm.
